Title: Public preview: Visual Studio support for Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps is a service for building and deploying modern applications and microservices using serverless containers. You can now use Visual Studio 2022 Preview 2 support to publish .NET Core applications to Azure Container Apps.

Learn more.
